title: GEOMETRY
markdownDescription:
En: Detector geometry definition via GEOMETRY.OBJECTS subsections (ObjectManager.cc).
Ru: Определение геометрии детектора через подсекции GEOMETRY.OBJECTS (ObjectManager.cc).

See: ObjectManager.cc.

Example:
```yaml
GEOMETRY:
  OBJECTS:
    target:
      name: "Target"
      shape: "box"
      material: "G4_WATER"
      DIMENSIONS: ["5*cm", "5*cm", "5*cm"]
      POSITION: [0, 0, 0]
      isSensitive: true
```

OBJECTS.markdownDescription:
En: Detector objects. Each key is an object ID, value is object definition.
Ru: Объекты детектора. Каждый ключ — ID объекта, значение — определение объекта.

Configuration keys per object: name, shape, material, DIMENSIONS, POSITION, isSensitive, DIGITIZE.*, cuts.*, max_step_size, record_ion_production, isotopes, isotope.
